description: Base permissions for the main window. This file replaces the capability tauri-build generates when the directory is absent, so core:default has to be listed explicitly. Two permissions are added on top. start-dragging: the title bar is an overlay and the tab strip stands in for it, so the window is dragged from the webview. core:window:default grants internal-toggle-maximize but not start-dragging, which is why double-click zoomed the window and dragging did nothing. destroy is what the close confirmation calls once you say yes — close() would re-enter the same close-requested handler and loop.
